title: Maxence Lacroix transfer news: Chelsea agree deal to sign France defender from Crystal Palace
summary: Chelsea have agreed a deal with Crystal Palace for defender Maxence Lacroix. The 26-year-old joined the Eagles from Wolfsburg in 2024, helping them win the FA Cup and UEFA Conference League.

title: Chelsea closing in on deal for France centre back Maxence Lacroix
summary: Chelsea are on the verge of completing a deal for Crystal Palace centre-back Maxence Lacroix. The 26-year-old is set to undergo a medical before signing a six-year contract at Stamford Bridge. According to The Athletic, Chelsea are finalizing the transfer in a deal worth around 52 million pounds. The defender is scheduled to undergo a medical on Friday before committing to a contract that runs until 2032.

title: Chelsea strike agreement for Palace defender Maxence Lacroix
summary: Chelsea have struck an agreement for Palace defender Maxence Lacroix. Agreement in place with official bid accepted by Crystal Palace. Broad terms in place last night and medical ongoing in London for the centre-back. 52m transfer fee. Lacroix signs until June 2032.

title: Vinicius Junior to stay at the Santiago Bernabeu beyond this summer despite Arsenal interest
summary: Vinicius Junior had been a target for Arsenal, but looks set to stay at Real Madrid beyond this summer's transfer window. Jose Mourinho is understood to value the Brazilian highly. Sky Sports News revealed on Monday that talks over his future would take place this week.

title: Real Madrid to hold further talks over Vinicius Jr future this week amid Arsenal interest
summary: Arsenal are exploring a deal that would bring Real Madrid star Vinicius Jr to the Emirates Stadium. The Premier League champions are aiming to improve their left-wing attacking options this season.

title: Transfer rumors: Vinicius Jr set to stay at Madrid, despite Arsenal interest
summary: Real Madrid are confident that Vinicius Junior will not depart this summer, while Liverpool want Aston Villa's Ezri Konsa.

title: Done Deals: Every official transfer completed around Europe today
summary: Arsenal have signed Christos Tzolis for 40m euros and Illan Meslier on a free transfer. Chelsea have permanently sold Marc Cucurella, Andrey Santos and Tyrique George to Real Madrid, Manchester United and Everton respectively, while Alejandro Garnacho has joined Aston Villa on loan with a conditional obligation to buy. Alongside Santos, Man Utd have signed Youri Tielemans and Karl Darlow on a free transfer. BBC Sport understands Chelsea are on the verge of signing France defender Maxence Lacroix after they agreed a fee with Crystal Palace.

title: Arsenal discover how far Guimaraes will go to seal move as Isak saga resurfaces
summary: Eddie Howe has admitted that he cannot guarantee that Bruno Guimaraes will still be a Newcastle player come the start of the season. Arsenal continue to be linked with the midfielder, with talkSPORT reporting the north London club are ready to accelerate talks over a move.

title: Liverpool identify dream Premier League alternative for Barcola
summary: The Times report that Paris Saint-Germain have placed a 145 million pound valuation on Bradley Barcola, with both Arsenal and Liverpool monitoring his situation. Liverpool have identified an alternative target.

title: Mohamed Salah: Besiktas make official transfer statement over Liverpool icon
summary: Besiktas have made an official statement regarding their reported interest in Liverpool forward Mohamed Salah.
